sentences.span: Thursday's selloff hit the spending recipients [the 72 S&P companies selling picks-and-shovels into the AI buildout]... the hyperscalers [buyers/spenders]... is up
sentences.why: The source says the equity selloff hit the suppliers/sellers into data centers (semis, power, cooling — the 'spending recipients'), while the hyperscalers who are actually spending on data centers (and are the credit/bond issuers) were UP and whose credit stayed calm. The sentence inverts this: it claims the selloff hit 'the companies spending on data centers' rather than 'the ones issuing bonds' — but the spenders and the bond issuers are the same group (hyperscalers) and they were the ones unaffected, not the ones hit.
